name: Applications of Computational Fluid Dynamics
description: Introduction to computational fluid dynamics turbulent flows, turbulence modeling, introduction to large eddy simulation and direct numerical simulations, multiphase flows, modeling approaches including continuum models [two-fluid, multi-fluid model (with population balances), mixture model, kinetic theory of granular flows (KTGF)], porous media, discrete particle models (discrete particle/element models, particle tracking in turbulent flows), free surface model (volume-of-fluid, level set methods), heat transport, problems involving conductive and convective heat transport, reactive flows, species transport without and with chemical reactions. Practical activities: flow through pipe, single phase stirred vessels, gas-liquid bubble columns, gas-liquid stirred vessels, gas-solid fluidized beds, gas-liquid-solid slurry reactors, gas-solid fixed beds, gas-liquid-solid trickle bed, liquid-liquid flows, liquid spreading on solid surfaces and micro-fluidic multiphase flows, etc.
